english.title: Casino premises licence holder fail to produce authorisation to constable / enforcement officer - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a casino premises licence, failed without reasonable excuse to produce a copy of an authorisation given by you under section 174(3) of the Gambling Act 2005 after having been required by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an enforcement officer]_

to do so within a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 316(3), (5) and (6) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes:
(i) Section 174(3) of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that the holder of a casino premises licence may authorise a person in writing to use the premises for the provision of facilities for bingo and/or betting.
(ii) The "specified period" is set by the constable or enforcement officer making the request
